            if key not in seg:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing key {key} in segment")
        if not isinstance(seg["importance"], int) or not isinstance(seg["minimum"], int) or not isinstance(seg["capacity"], int):
            raise ValueError("Importance, minimum, capacity must be integers")
    total_min = sum(seg["minimum"] for seg in segments)
    total_cap = sum(seg["capacity"] for seg in segments)
    if budget < total_min or budget > total_cap:
        raise ValueError("Budget out of feasible range")
    # Initial allocations
    allocations = [seg["minimum"] for seg in segments]
    remaining = budget - total_min
    # Greedy allocation
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_score = -1.0
        for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
            if allocations[i] < seg["capacity"]:
                # score = importance / (current_alloc + 1)
                score = seg["importance"] / (allocations[i] + 1)
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_idx = i
                elif score == best_score and best_idx == -1:
                    # This case should not happen because best_idx set above
                    pass
        # If all segments at capacity, remaining should be 0, but ensure
        if best_idx == -1:
            break
        allocations[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    # Build by_name
    by_name = {seg["name"]: allocations[i] for i, seg in enumerate(segments)}
    total = sum(allocations)
    return {"allocations": allocations, "by_name": by_name, "total": total}
